discovery_source.name: Awesome Open Source Trading
discovery_source.count_note: Software category counts may overlap. This registry is a curated architecture-relevant subset, not a line-by-line audit of every indexed repository.
discovery_source.status_note: The index contains activity labels and a September 2026 popularity/activity snapshot; re-check repository state, default branch, releases and license before adoption.

adoption_policy.rule: A repository may be studied without being copied or added as a runtime dependency. No external project becomes a core dependency solely because it is popular or has an impressive README.

projects.name: NautilusTrader
projects.role: Primary architecture reference for deterministic event-driven multi-asset trading, backtesting and execution.
limitations_or_review: Check stable versus development/release-candidate branches.
Do not assume all adapters or simulation models have identical fidelity.
projects.source_review_level: public repository/documentation review; no complete line-by-line audit claimed
